plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Medical Administrative Technology, Associate in Applied Science - 64 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/25, Effective Date: 08/25; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Sequenced TERM 1-4 as printed; term totals 16/16/15/17 = 64 reconcile exactly. The map requires ten credit hours of emphasis electives to complete the AAS degree (10 sh sequenced in Term 4). Genuine catalog typos kept verbatim: 'LIFE 1411 Anatomy & Pysiology for the Pre-Hospital Provider'; 'ADHC 1501 Essentials of Electrocradiogram (EKG)'; the map prints 'ENGL 1236 Technical Communication' (singular). Certified Medical Administrative Assistant exam (NHA) eligibility is a milestone. Do not recommend PSYC 1000 and SOCI 1100 in the same semester (advising note).
